title: Gemini & Zocdoc launch AI doctor booking
summary: Oliver Kharraz, Zocdoc Founder & CEO discusses teaming up with Google (GOOG) to integrate real-time healthcare appointment booking directly into the Gemini app, reducing patient wait times from 31 days to 72 hours while maintaining data privacy.

title: Google becomes latest company to raise prices thanks to memory shortage
summary: The AI-driven memory shortage strikes again.

title: The Investment Company of America, AIVSX, Has Outlasted Nearly Every Fund Launched Beside It
summary: One mutual fund launched in the 1930s survived the dot-com bust, a global financial crisis, and a pandemic without closing its doors, and it still manages more money than most countries hold in reserves. Whether that staying power translates into a smart buy in 2026 is a very different question.

title: David Abrams's Top Second Quarter 2026 Move: Alphabet Inc at a -3.07% Portfolio Impact
summary: David Abrams (Trades, Portfolio), founder and CEO of Abrams Capital Management, recently submitted his 13F filing for the second quarter of 2026, revealing key adjustments to his concentrated portfolio.  Abrams established the Boston-based firm in 1999 after a decade working alongside Seth Klarman (Trades, Portfolio) at Baupost Group.  David Abrams (Trades, Portfolio) reduced his position in one stock during the quarter, with the most significant change being a reduction in Alphabet Inc (NASDAQ:GOOGL).

title: OpenAI's New Revenue Officer Comes From Alphabet's Wiz
summary: The appointment signals a move toward performance and metrics frameworks. OpenAI must improve reliance on the tracking tools it offers advertisers before more will increase their ad budgets with OpenAI.
